scope: Public Mendix 11.12.1 input-text and popup edit witness; not certification of every project or edit operation
reconstruction: Public Ruby edits, with the runtime MPR removed before compilation

negative_witness.cause: A defined LabelTemplate and a ScreenReaderLabel cannot coexist, even with empty visible text
negative_witness.correction: The public fixture has LabelTemplate nil before export; the native rule is not bypassed

limits: Only the first projected translation is editable; other languages and template parameters are preserved
Input text containers and popup fields must already exist in the native baseline
Application-specific consistency rules still require Mendix validation
